theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (p : Amb n ℓ → (Amb n ℓ →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ)) (ζ y : Amb n ℓ) (s ω c : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < ω → AEStronglyMeasurable p μ → (∀ x, ‖p x‖ ≤ 1) → μ (closedBall ζ s) = 0 → μ (closedBall ζ (3 * s)) ≠ ⊤ → dist y ζ ≤ 2 * s → ENNReal.ofReal (ω * s ^ n / 2) ≤ μ (closedBall y s) → c ≤ ω / (4 * 3 ^ n) → ((3 * s) ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall ζ (3 * s))).toReal ≤ Real.exp 2 * ((s ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall ζ s)).toReal) + c + Real.exp 2 * ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s) \ closedBall ζ s, ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - ζ‖ ^ (n + 2) ∂μ → s ^ (n + 2) ≤ 4 * 3 ^ n * Real.exp 2 / ω * ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s), ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
